notes: The ASV writes one word, *which*, where two morphemes point at the antecedent, so the relative takes it and the resumptive suffix is unrepresented under rule 22, its preposition unrepresented under rule 40 — the same count rule 43 runs for אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם → *that hath a blemish*.
The volitive *let … save* joins the jussive verb, discontinuous around the explicit הֵמָּה, which keeps only its own *them* (rules 17, 20, 25).
